import pytest
from rich.cells import split_text, _split_text


def test_split_text_at_zero_position():
    """Test splitting at column zero returns empty left and full text on right."""
    text = "Hello"
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "Hello"


def test_split_text_at_zero_position_mixed_widths():
    """Test splitting at column zero with mixed single and double-cell chars."""
    # Using some characters with potentially different cell widths
    text = "Hello世界"
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "Hello世界"


def test_split_text_at_zero_position_empty_string():
    """Test splitting empty string at column zero."""
    text = ""
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == ""


def test_split_text_at_zero_position_double_width_chars():
    """Test splitting at column zero with double-width characters."""
    text = "世界"
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "世界"

import pytest
from rich.cells import split_text


def test_split_text_mixed_widths_middle():
    """Test splitting mixed single and double-cell characters in the middle."""
    text = "H世界o"  # H(1) + 世(2) + 界(2) + o(1)
    # At position 1: should split after "H"
    left, right = split_text(text, 1)
    assert left == "H"
    assert right == "世界o"

    text = "A世B"  # A(1) + 世(2) + B(1)
    
    # Position 0
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "A世B"
    
    # Position 1 (after A)
    left, right = split_text(text, 1)
    assert left == "A"
    assert right == "世B"

import pytest
from rich.cells import split_text


def test_split_text_double_width_char_replacement():
    """Test that cutting inside a two-cell character replaces it with two spaces."""
    # Create text with a double-width character
    text = "A世B"  # A(1) + 世(2) + B(1)
    # Total: 4 cells. Positions: A=0-1, 世=1-3, B=3-4
    
    # Split at position 2 (inside the double-width character 世)
    left, right = split_text(text, 2)
    # The double-width character should be replaced with spaces
    assert left == "A "
    assert right == " B"
    assert len(left) == 2
    assert len(right) == 2

import pytest
from rich.cells import split_text


def test_split_text_single_cell_all_positions():
    """Test all valid split positions for single-cell width text."""
    text = "ABC"
    
    # Position 0
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "ABC"
    
    # Position 1
    left, right = split_text(text, 1)
    assert left == "A"
    assert right == "BC"
    
    # Position 2
    left, right = split_text(text, 2)
    assert left == "AB"
    assert right == "C"
    
    # Position 3 (at end)
    left, right = split_text(text, 3)
    assert left == "ABC"
    assert right == ""


def test_split_text_negative_position():
    """Test that negative positions are handled like zero."""
    text = "Hello"
    left, right = split_text(text, -1)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "Hello"
    
    left, right = split_text(text, -5)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "Hello"

import pytest
from rich.segment import Segment
from rich.style import Style


def test_segment_split_cells_at_zero():
    """Test Segment.split_cells at position zero."""
    segment = Segment("Hello", Style())
    left, right = segment.split_cells(0)
    assert left.text == ""
    assert right.text == "Hello"
    assert left.style == Style()
    assert right.style == Style()


def test_segment_split_cells_middle():
    """Test Segment.split_cells in the middle."""
    segment = Segment("Hello", Style(bold=True))
    left, right = segment.split_cells(2)
    assert left.text == "He"
    assert right.text == "llo"
    assert left.style == Style(bold=True)
    assert right.style == Style(bold=True)


def test_segment_split_cells_at_end():
    """Test Segment.split_cells at end."""
    segment = Segment("Hello", Style())
    left, right = segment.split_cells(5)
    assert left.text == "Hello"
    assert right.text == ""

import pytest
from rich.segment import Segment
from rich.style import Style


def test_segment_split_cells_double_width_replacement():
    """Test double-width character handling in Segment.split_cells."""
    segment = Segment("A世B", Style())
    # Split at position 2 (inside double-width character)
    left, right = segment.split_cells(2)
    assert left.text == "A "
    assert right.text == " B"


def test_segment_split_cells_with_control():
    """Test Segment.split_cells with control codes."""
    segment = Segment("Hello", Style(), control=(("test",),))
    left, right = segment.split_cells(2)
    # When control is present, it should still split the text
    assert left.text == "He"
    assert right.text == "llo"
    assert left.control == (("test",),)
    assert right.control == (("test",),)


def test_segment_split_cells_past_end():
    """Test Segment.split_cells past the end."""
    segment = Segment("Hi", Style())
    left, right = segment.split_cells(100)
    assert left.text == "Hi"
    assert right.text == ""
